mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. If you've ever wondered how our deepest questions about the divine have shaped not just religions, but entire civilizations, you're in the right place. Over four thousand years, the search for God has inspired revolutions, sparked grand philosophical debates, and woven a rich tapestry of belief and tradition. Together, we're about to explore how the idea of God has evolved through the intertwined paths of Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. And as Karen Armstrong shows us in her remarkable book, A History of God: The 4000-Year Quest of Judaism, Christianity and Islam, this journey is about much more than theology—it's a reflection of our longing for meaning, connection, and something greater than ourselves. Along the way, we'll meet ancient prophets, Sufi mystics, and medieval thinkers, each wrestling with questions that are as relevant now as they were centuries ago. We'll see how new beliefs emerged, how empires rose and fell, and how faith and reason have danced together—sometimes in harmony, sometimes in tension. Get ready to look at the story of God as a mirror—one that reveals not just the history of belief, but also the endless search for unity in a world full of diversity. Together, let's open the door to centuries of spiritual discovery, and see what insights we can bring into our own modern lives.
